verdict.rationale: Docs claim a single CLI command starts a local model 'offline and without an account' (docs-6/7/14), implying start capability, but there is no explicit 'stop' command documented, and hands-on community reports describe the CLI (rcli) segfaulting and failing to run correctly on multiple install methods (comm-3, comm-9, comm-14), directly contradicting the smooth one-command experience claimed. Missing for 10: documented stop/shutdown command, reliable independent confirmation that start works as advertised, and any mention of process management (status/logs).
